svg.title: PostHog: analytics, SQL and feature flags through PostHog's MCP server
svg.desc: Inside your agent, the PostHog capability connects to PostHog's hosted MCP server at mcp.posthog.com/mcp with a personal API key as a bearer token. By default the server offers one command-driven tool, which the model sees as posthog_posthog. The features option is sent as a ?features= query that limits the server to those feature groups, and read_only=True sends the x-posthog-read-only header so the server drops every tool that makes changes.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
